subject: Shelford SOC 2 / SIG prep — scheduling, owners, and pre-read

Subject: Shelford — SOC 2 / SIG prep request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the intro (from our buyer). We’re kicking off an assurance review for our vendor stack and want to include Redwood in the scope. Could we schedule a 45–60 minute technical Q&A to walk through your SIG/CAIQ coverage, logging/retention practices, and any SOC 2 scoping constraints?

High level asks:
- Quick overview of which CAIQ/SIG artifacts you’ll provide (CAIQ v3 or SIG v2).
- Log export cadence and examples for API requests (sampling window).
- Confirmation on data residency and encryption at rest key management.

We have availability this week on Tue/Wed afternoon (PST). I can invite our security engineer and procurement lead. I attached a preliminary CAIQ and a short list of initial questions.

Can you confirm an owner on your side to coordinate evidence handoff?

Thanks,
Elaine Wu
Director, Information Security
Shelford Health

Thanks — Tue 2026-12-15 13:00–14:00 PST works for us. Please send a calendar invite and a video dial-in.

We’d prefer a short live walkthrough during the call and then an updated CAIQ file after the meeting. Priority areas for us: key management (KMS/HSM), multi-tenant separation and tenant identifiers in logs, and your retention windows for API request logs and user activity. Also, please be prepared to talk about your SOC 2 scope (does Redwood host customer data in shared log stores or segregated buckets?).

I’m attaching a PDF with our supplier questionnaire (high level) and the CAIQ you sent (we made a couple notes).
